steps.message: What is on my schedule for the Monday after next at 12am in Simple Calendar Pro? Answer with the titles only. If there are multiples titles, format your answer in a comma separated list.

Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z (%A)' ; pm list packages | grep -i simple ; ls -d /data/data/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro /data/user/0/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro 2>/dev/null ; ls -la /data/user/0/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro 2>/dev/null ; ls -la /data/user/0/com.simplemobiletools.calendar.pro/databases 2>/dev/null"
